svg.data-weight-configured-scope: configured with two fan trays, two RSPs, five fabric cards, and one PEM
svg.data-power-modules-v3: Version 3 power system - up to six AC power modules per system, three per tray
svg.data-power-ac-input-current: 15 A maximum at 200 VAC; 13 A maximum at 220 to 240 VRMS (UK)
svg.data-power-ac-redundancy: AC power modules operate in N+N redundancy mode
svg.data-cooling-path: front-to-rear; inlet at the bottom front, exhaust at the upper rear
svg.data-fan-trays: two, FT0 above FT1, on the rear face

circle.data-description: the single tri-colour Status LED. Table 9, 'FC Card LED Display Definitions', of the Overview and Reference Guide: green - FC card powered on and FPGA is programmed; red - fault or malfunction in FC card power up or FPGA programming; amber - FC card powered on but fabric not active; off - FC card powered off via CLI. Cisco's own note on the green state is worth carrying: 'Fabric Data Link failure is not detected so LED remains green'.
